thesis: Singular beauty can emerge through shared history without making intimacy infallible or interchangeable with rankings.

ideas.statement: Attraction, partnership, durable relationship and reproduction are distinct outcomes; a shared history can create value a higher score cannot replace.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The scar and imaginary societies are thought experiments; sincere admiration creates no duty of reciprocation even while exclusion hurts.
